verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents response guardrails that screen what the agent says for grounding and policy, with the ability to block, rewrite or escalate. It also scopes deployment to trained topics, leaving the rest with humans, which covers the core of stopping invented answers and routing off-knowledge questions to a safe outcome. Adversarial guardrail simulations and a human handoff path add support, but the evidence is entirely brief vendor marketing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a safe-decline behavior for off-knowledge questions, specifics on preventing invented prices, policies or promises, in-depth docs on how the grounding check works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
